content.title: Kpop Website
content.text: All About K-pop K-pop, short for Korean Pop Music, is a very popular music genre. It consists of all kinds of music; the main difference is that it is sung in Korean. Although K-pop has become more well-known over the past decade, it has actually been around since 1992. There have been over 300 K-pop groups since then. In order to become a K-pop idol, you have to train for many years, and learn how to sing, dance, and rap. In this website, we will look into some of the most popular K-pop groups today, and then take a quiz to test your knowledge.
